title: Playing MarketWatch's stock game from Python

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if you could run a virtual stock-trading game from a Python script?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That's the marketwatch library, a Python client for MarketWatch's virtual trading game.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, and that's the point. It only handles game interactions, with no connection to a brokerage account. Safe to experiment.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It wraps the whole flow: logging in, reading game information, and placing simulated orders.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So you can automate a strategy and see how it does, with nothing at stake.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. It's Apache licensed and tested with pytest. The full write-up has the details.
